description: Modify a zone constitutive model property. The property should accept a value of type float. While technically any valid type can be used here, none of the distribution keywords will apply and the zone property command should probably be used instead.

description.7.0: A Gaussian distribution is used to assign the property values randomly, with a mean of fvalue and standard deviation of f.
description.9.0: A Gaussian distribution is used to assign the property values randomly, with a mean of fvalue and standard deviation of f .

description.7.0: A uniform distribution is used to assign the property values randomly, with a mean value of fvalue and a standard deviation of f.
description.9.0: A uniform distribution is used to assign the property values randomly, with a mean value of fvalue and a standard deviation of f .

description.7.0: Apply a gradient to the property value.
description.9.0: Apply a gradient to the property value. Note the origin keyword is optional, however, the default value (0,0,0) is used if the origin keyword is not included in the command — which may not produce the intended result.

keywords.name: add
keywords.description: Add fvalue to the property value.

description.7.0: Multiply the property value by fvalue.
description.9.0: Multiply the property value by fvalue .

keywords.name: vary
keywords.description: Apply a linear variation to the property value.

keywords.name: deviation-lognormal
keywords.description: A log-normal distribution is used to assign the property values randomly. In other words, the natural logarithm of property values is a Gaussian distribution with a mean of fvalue and standard deviation of f . Because fvalue is the mean of the logarithm, 18 gives values near 7e7, and a value such as 1e8 overflows.

keywords.name: density
keywords.description: Assign zone density instead of a constitutive model property; density is stored on the zone. The distribution keywords apply to it in the same way.

verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/flac3d/zone/doc/manual/zone_manual/zone_commands/cmd_zone.property-distribution.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
